The source starts at 100.  
To keep the next round at 100, we need the remaining after this round to be at least 100, i.e.  
\( (100 - x) * 2 + 5 \ge 100 \).  
Solving gives \(x \le 52.5\).  
Thus the largest whole number we can safely take is 52.
